snippet.title: crockpot trailer
snippet.description:
trailer for crockpot
https://koonce.itch.io/crockpot

trailer song: F.U.A. by TV Dinner

a game by emily koonce & blake andrews
written, programmed, & designed by emily koonce
illustrated, animated, & designed by blake andrews
voice acted by emily koonce & blake andrews





crockpot runs around 25 minutes. 

it is recommended to play the game in a single sitting with headphones.




release party at boshi's place in brooklyn, ny
june 15, 2024
